title.zh: 美联储10比2维持利率不变，比特币重回8.1万美元上方
title.en: Fed holds rates in 10-2 vote as Bitcoin climbs back above $81,000

summary.zh: 美联储10月28日以10比2的投票结果维持联邦基金利率 (Federal Funds Rate) 在3.75%至4.00%不变，两名委员主张加息25个基点，市场则预计12月加息的概率接近83%。比特币在决议公布后回升至8.1万美元上方，以太币 (Ether) 同步上涨约0.6%至2360美元附近。分析人士指出，由于本次按兵不动早已被市场消化，12月会议的政策信号以及10月29日公布的GDP与PCE通胀数据将成为下一步行情的关键。
summary.en: The Federal Reserve held the federal funds target range at 3.75% to 4.00% on October 28 in a 10-2 vote, with two officials favoring a quarter-point hike, while markets priced in a roughly 83% chance of a December increase. Bitcoin climbed back above $81,000 after the decision and ether rose about 0.6% to near $2,360. With the hold widely expected, traders now look to December policy signals and the GDP and PCE inflation data due October 29 for the next directional cue.

title.zh: 美国现货以太币ETF 10月净流出达13.2亿美元，逼近去年11月纪录
title.en: US spot ether ETFs bleed $1.32 billion in October, nearing November 2025 record

summary.zh: 美国现货以太币ETF (Spot Ether ETF) 在10月27日再流出约6020万美元，10月累计净流出达到约13.2亿美元，距离2025年11月创下的14.2亿美元月度纪录仅一步之遥。以太币同期在2300美元附近徘徊，机构资金连续数周撤离，Glamsterdam升级推迟进一步打压市场情绪。分析人士认为，若以太币能守住2280至2300美元支撑区并有效突破2500美元，资金流向才可能出现好转。
summary.en: US spot ether ETFs lost about $60.2 million on October 27, taking October net outflows to roughly $1.32 billion, close to the $1.42 billion monthly record set in November 2025. Ether hovered near $2,300 as institutional money kept leaving for a fifth straight week, with the delayed Glamsterdam upgrade adding to weak sentiment. Analysts say holding the $2,280 to $2,300 support zone and reclaiming $2,500 would be needed to turn flows around.

title.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF两日吸金2.86亿美元，10月净流出收窄至约2600万美元
title.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs draw $286 million over two days, narrowing October outflows to about $26 million

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 在10月27日录得1.76亿美元净流入，延续前一日1.1亿美元的回流势头，两日合计吸金2.86亿美元，10月累计净流出随之收窄至约2600万美元。资金流入由贝莱德 (BlackRock) 与富达 (Fidelity) 领衔，显示机构需求正在修复，但以太币与Solana基金同期仍在流出。市场关注第三个交易日的流入能否延续，以确认机构配置回暖而非短暂反弹。
summary.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $176 million in net inflows on October 27, extending the previous day's $110 million rebound to a two-day total of $286 million and narrowing October's net outflows to about $26 million. Inflows were led by BlackRock and Fidelity, signaling repairing institutional demand, even as ether and Solana funds kept losing money. Traders now watch whether a third straight inflow day confirms rebuilding institutional allocation rather than a brief bounce.

title.zh: 三星钱包Solana版USDC跨境汇款进入上线周，8200万台设备迎来首测
title.en: Samsung Wallet's Solana USDC remittance rollout reaches launch week across 82 million devices

summary.zh: 三星钱包 (Samsung Wallet) 内置的Solana版USDC (USD Coin) 跨境汇款功能按计划在10月最后一周向美国用户推出，覆盖8200万台Galaxy设备，用户无需另装加密应用即可向兼容钱包或60多个国家的银行账户汇款。托管由Coinbase Prime与Bastion提供，Solana与Sui提供底层区块链支持，三星对外部钱包转账不收取费用。市场关注的焦点已从上线规模转向实际完成率、到账速度与失败交易的客服体验。
summary.en: Samsung Wallet's built-in Solana-based USDC cross-border remittance feature is due to reach US users in the final week of October, covering 82 million Galaxy devices without requiring a separate crypto app, with transfers to compatible wallets or bank accounts in more than 60 countries. Custody comes from Coinbase Prime and Bastion, with Solana and Sui providing blockchain infrastructure, and Samsung charges no fee on transfers to external wallets. Attention now shifts from launch scale to completion rates, payout speed and how failed transfers are handled.

title.zh: 新加坡警方：两名用户因购买被植入恶意硬件的Ledger钱包损失350万新元
title.en: Singapore police: two users lose S$3.5 million from Ledger wallets fitted with malicious hardware

summary.zh: 新加坡警方10月28日通报，自9月10日以来已接获两起案件，两名用户因在当地零售店购买了被植入恶意硬件组件的Ledger硬件钱包，合计损失约350万新元加密货币。初步调查显示，这些恶意组件可窃取助记词 (Recovery Phrase) 或私钥，使他人无需用户同意即可转移资产，Ledger正在复核相关案件。警方呼吁公众只通过可信渠道购买硬件钱包，并对疑似被篡改的设备立即将资产转移至新生成助记词的可信钱包。
summary.en: Singapore police said on October 28 that two users have collectively lost about S$3.5 million in cryptocurrency after buying Ledger hardware wallets from local retail stores that contained malicious hardware components, in cases reported since September 10. Preliminary investigations found the components could capture recovery phrases or private keys, letting others move assets without the owners' consent, and Ledger is reviewing the cases. Police urged the public to buy only through trusted channels and to move funds to a new wallet with a freshly generated recovery phrase if a device is suspected of tampering.

title.zh: 贝森特：财政部将协调SEC与CFTC填补CLARITY法案留下的监管空白
title.en: Bessent: Treasury will coordinate SEC and CFTC to fill gap left by stalled CLARITY Act

summary.zh: 美国财长贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 在10月27日Ripple的Swell大会上表示，在CLARITY法案于参议院受阻后，财政部将运用召集权协调证券交易委员会 (SEC) 与商品期货交易委员会 (CFTC)，以机构行动填补监管空白，并制定防止加密企业被银行断供 (Debanking) 的最佳实践与护栏。他同时把美元稳定币描绘为维护美元地位的战略工具，称超过90%的稳定币与美元挂钩，发行方持有的美债储备可为美国国债带来新的需求来源。
summary.en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said at Ripple's Swell conference on October 27 that, with the CLARITY Act stalled in the Senate, Treasury will use its convening power to coordinate the SEC and CFTC through agency action, including best practices and guardrails against debanking crypto firms. He also cast dollar-backed stablecoins as a strategic tool for preserving the dollar's standing, noting that more than 90% of stablecoins are dollar-pegged and that issuers' Treasury reserves could create new demand for US government debt.

title.zh: Galaxy：比特币熊市已于6月结束，市场进入历史上屡次先于上涨的积累阶段
title.en: Galaxy: Bitcoin bear market ended in June, market now in accumulation phase that preceded past rallies

summary.zh: Galaxy研究主管Alex Thorn表示，比特币熊市已于6月结束，当时比特币跌破5.8万美元，如今市场正处于历史上每次大涨之前都出现过的积累阶段 (Accumulation Phase)，比特币已重回50周均线上方且抛压减轻。比特币在美联储决议前夕回升至8.1万美元附近，Galaxy认为这是值得积累的时点，但市场仍需关注美联储主席沃什 (Kevin Warsh) 对12月加息的表态。这一判断属于机构观点而非价格预测，实际走势仍取决于宏观数据与资金流向。
summary.en: Galaxy's head of firmwide research Alex Thorn said Bitcoin's bear market ended in June, when it traded below $58,000, and that the market is now in an accumulation phase that has preceded every prior advance, with Bitcoin back above its 50-week moving average and selling pressure lighter. Bitcoin recovered toward $81,000 ahead of the Federal Reserve decision, and Galaxy framed current levels as a time to accumulate, while cautioning that Chair Kevin Warsh's guidance on a December hike remains a key variable. The call is an institutional view, not a price forecast, and the outcome still hinges on macro data and fund flows.

title.zh: Bithumb内部移动系统遭黑客入侵致数据泄露，交易所称客户资产未受影响
title.en: Bithumb internal mobile system hacked in data leak; exchange says customer funds unaffected

summary.zh: 韩国第二大加密交易所Bithumb确认，其员工内部移动办公系统10月27日遭外部黑客入侵并导致个人信息泄露，已向韩国互联网振兴院 (KISA) 与个人信息保护委员会通报，泄露范围仍在调查中。Bithumb强调内部办公系统与虚拟资产交易系统物理隔离，客户资产无法经由此次入侵触及。此事正值韩国金融业接连遭网络攻击，警方已对包括Bithumb在内的多家机构展开初步调查，尚未确认各案是否出自同一攻击者。
summary.en: South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange Bithumb confirmed that hackers breached its internal employee mobile system on October 27, leaking personal information, and that it has notified the Korea Internet & Security Agency and the Personal Information Protection Commission while the scope is still being assessed. Bithumb stressed that the internal system is physically separated from its virtual-asset trading system, so customer funds cannot be reached through this breach. The incident comes amid a wave of attacks on Korean financial firms, with police opening a preliminary probe covering Bithumb and others, without yet confirming a common attacker.

title.zh: Solana代币化现实资产持有人达170万，代币化股票贡献九成以上新增
title.en: Solana tokenized real-world asset holders reach 1.7 million, tokenized stocks drive over 90% of growth

summary.zh: Blockworks数据显示，截至10月25日，Solana链上代币化现实资产 (RWA) 持有人数在6天内增加逾10.9万，达到约170万，其中代币化股票贡献了10.56万，占新增的九成以上。代币化商品、信贷与国债亦小幅增长，收藏品则略有下降，显示Solana的机构金融叙事正由代币化股票主导。这一趋势与三星钱包USDC汇款等主流应用落地相呼应，但链上费用与DeFi锁仓仍相对温和， adoption能否转化为SOL需求仍有待观察。
summary.en: Blockworks data showed Solana tokenized real-world asset holders grew by more than 109,000 addresses in six days to about 1.7 million by October 25, with tokenized equities contributing 105,648 of the increase, over 90% of net growth. Tokenized commodities, credit and government debt also rose slightly while collectibles slipped, showing tokenized stocks dominating Solana's institutional-finance story. The trend echoes mainstream rollouts like Samsung Wallet's USDC remittances, though network fees and DeFi TVL remain modest, leaving open whether adoption will translate into SOL demand.

title.zh: 散户向币安存入比特币规模翻倍，巨鲸自6月以来首次转向看空
title.en: Retail Bitcoin deposits to Binance nearly double while whales turn bearish for first time since June

summary.zh: CryptoQuant数据显示，过去30天散户向币安存入的比特币接近108亿美元，约为此前的两倍，而大户存入量降至38亿美元，显示散户正借反弹抛售。The Motley Fool指出，巨鲸自6月以来首次转向看空，尽管10月27日市场随美股反弹，比特币仍在8万美元附近挣扎。分析人士认为，若比特币能守住8万美元区域，将为反弹打开空间，而持续站上8.7万美元才是买方重新掌控的更明确信号。
summary.en: CryptoQuant data showed retail Bitcoin deposits to Binance nearly doubled to about $10.8 billion over 30 days, while large-holder deposits fell to $3.8 billion, suggesting smaller investors used the rebound to sell. The Motley Fool noted whales turned bearish for the first time since June, even as the market rallied with US stocks on October 27 and Bitcoin struggled near $80,000. Holding $80,000 would be encouraging for buyers, while a sustained move above $87,000 would more convincingly signal a broader recovery.

title.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF单日回流1.1亿美元，10月仍净流出约2.02亿美元
title.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs claw back $110 million in a day, but October stays about $202 million in net outflows

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 在10月26日录得1.1亿美元净流入，扭转了此前两个交易日合计7.74亿美元的净流出，但10月迄今仍净流出约2.02亿美元。比特币同期在约7.96万美元附近交易，7日跌幅约2.6%，加密恐惧与贪婪指数 (Crypto Fear & Greed Index) 回落至48，仍处于中性区间。市场焦点转向10月28日结束的美联储会议，交易员普遍预计利率维持在3.75%至4.00%不变。
summary.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $110 million in net inflows on October 26, reversing $774 million of withdrawals over the previous two trading sessions, though October remained about $202 million in net outflows. Bitcoin traded near $79,600, down about 2.6% over seven days, while the Crypto Fear & Greed Index slipped to 48, still in neutral territory. Attention now turns to the Federal Reserve meeting ending October 28, with rates widely expected to stay at 3.75% to 4.00%.

title.zh: Keystone硬件钱包验证密钥被盗，公司将销毁18835台库存设备
title.en: Keystone to destroy 18,835 hardware wallets after attackers steal device verification key

summary.zh: 硬件钱包厂商Keystone表示，攻击者10月20日通过其网站第三方数据监控工具的漏洞提权，窃取了用于验证设备真伪的WebAuth密钥 (WebAuth Key)，并获取了25964条买家记录。持有该密钥者可能制造通过官方验证的仿冒设备，Keystone因此将销毁18835台库存设备，并暂停发货、改为预售，直至新密钥设备投产。公司强调，助记词 (Recovery Phrase)、私钥和银行支付信息未受影响，10月20日前交付且通过验证的设备仍可正常使用。
summary.en: Hardware wallet maker Keystone said attackers escalated privileges through a flaw in a third-party data monitoring tool on its website on October 20, stealing the WebAuth key used to verify devices as genuine along with 25,964 buyer records. Whoever holds the key could build counterfeit devices that pass official checks, so Keystone will destroy 18,835 units in inventory, suspend shipments and switch to preorders until new-key devices are produced. Recovery phrases, private keys and bank payment details were not involved, and devices delivered before October 20 that pass verification remain safe to use.

title.zh: Ripple获得美国货币监理署最终批准，可开设国家信托银行
title.en: Ripple wins final OCC approval to launch its US national trust bank

summary.zh: 美国货币监理署 (Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, OCC) 已给予Ripple国家信托银行最终批准，完成了自2025年12月获得有条件批准以来的特许流程。该银行将管理支撑稳定币RLUSD的隔离储备、担任RLUSD持有人的抵押受托人，并为机构客户提供数字资产托管服务。RLUSD仍由Ripple旗下受纽约州金融服务局监管的Standard Custody & Trust Company发行，国家信托银行本身不吸收存款、不发放贷款，也不享有联邦存款保险。
summary.en: The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has granted final approval for Ripple National Trust Bank, completing a chartering process that began with conditional approval in December 2025. The bank will manage the segregated reserves backing the RLUSD stablecoin, act as collateral trustee for RLUSD holders and provide digital asset custody to institutional clients. RLUSD will still be issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, Ripple's New York-regulated trust company, and the trust bank itself takes no deposits, makes no loans and carries no federal deposit insurance.

title.zh: Strategy在10月19日至25日一周未买比特币，转而回购2.049亿美元STRC优先股
title.en: Strategy buys no Bitcoin in October 19-25 week, spending $204.9 million on STRC buybacks instead

summary.zh: Strategy在10月26日提交的8-K文件 (Form 8-K) 中披露，10月19日至25日一周内既未买入也未卖出比特币，持仓维持在848517枚，账面成本约640.2亿美元，平均成本约75446美元。同期公司斥资2.049亿美元回购约207万股STRC可变利率优先股，并保留约48.3亿美元的指定美元储备。公司未通过场内增发 (At-the-Market Offering) 出售股份，这是其近期连续增持告一段落后，资本配置重心转向优先股负担的一周。
summary.en: Strategy disclosed in an 8-K filed on October 26 that it neither bought nor sold Bitcoin in the week of October 19-25, leaving holdings unchanged at 848,517 BTC at an aggregate cost of about $64.02 billion, or roughly $75,446 per coin. Over the same week it spent $204.9 million repurchasing about 2.07 million STRC variable-rate preferred shares, while retaining about $4.83 billion in designated dollar reserves. It sold no shares under its at-the-market equity program, in a week when capital allocation shifted toward its preferred-stock obligations after a run of purchases.

title.zh: PrimeRevenue将电子定期汇票上链Solana，传统贸易金融迈入链上市场
title.en: PrimeRevenue tokenizes electronic time drafts on Solana, bringing trade finance on-chain

summary.zh: 营运资金解决方案公司PrimeRevenue宣布，将其专利电子定期汇票 (Electronic Time Draft, ETD) 在Solana上代币化，作为把传统贸易金融带入去中心化金融的第一步。ETD代表买方在未来约定日期支付指定金额的义务，上链后每次发行、转让、生命周期事件和到期结算都可记录在可验证的共享账本上。PrimeRevenue平台服务于5万家公司、100多家融资伙伴，年支付交易规模超过3000亿美元，未来计划把更多营运资金工具上链。
summary.en: Working capital firm PrimeRevenue said it is tokenizing its patented Electronic Time Draft (ETD) instrument on Solana, its first step toward bringing traditional trade finance to decentralized finance. An ETD represents a buyer's obligation to pay a specified amount on a defined future date, and moving it on-chain records each issuance, transfer, lifecycle event and maturity settlement on a verifiable shared record. PrimeRevenue's platform serves 50,000 companies and more than 100 funding partners with over $300 billion in annual payment transactions, and it plans to bring more working capital instruments on-chain.

title.zh: CoinDCX确认再失窃约1600万美元，两次事件合计损失近6000万美元
title.en: CoinDCX confirms another $16 million theft, taking combined losses from two incidents to nearly $60 million

summary.zh: 印度交易所CoinDCX确认，在自动资金划转系统故障后，约1599万USDT从此前已遭入侵的旧钱包中流失，此前其首席执行官曾将相关报告斥为“虚惊一场”。该批钱包在2025年7月约4400万美元被盗事件后本应停用，但用户存款仍在其中累积，两次事件合计损失近6000万美元。CoinDCX表示已承担本次损失、用户资金安全，但链上调查员ZachXBT敦促用户提取资产，对交易所的披露节奏提出质疑。
summary.en: Indian exchange CoinDCX confirmed about 15.99 million USDT was lost from previously compromised wallets after its automated fund-transfer system failed, days after its CEO had dismissed reports of a new breach as a possible false alarm. The wallets were supposed to have been retired after a roughly $44 million hack in July 2025, but user deposits kept accumulating in them, bringing combined losses from the two incidents to nearly $60 million. CoinDCX said it absorbed the latest loss and that customer funds remain safe, while on-chain investigator ZachXBT urged users to withdraw assets and questioned the disclosure timeline.

title.zh: 以太坊推迟Glamsterdam的Hoodi测试网激活，原定10月26日的2亿Gas测试取消
title.en: Ethereum postpones Glamsterdam's Hoodi testnet activation, cancelling the planned October 26 200-million-gas test

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会10月22日宣布，核心开发者在第248次全体核心开发者执行层会议 (All Core Developers Execution, ACDE #248) 上决定推迟Glamsterdam在Hoodi测试网的激活，原定10月26日17:42:48 UTC的激活及2亿Gas上限计划一并取消，暂未公布新的激活日期。推迟的原因是需要进一步研究EIP-8037的Gas重定价与已部署主网智能合约的交互，安全公司ChainSecurity此前警告相关改动可能影响现有合约。此次推迟仅涉及测试网配置，不改变Hoodi已有链历史，也未设定以太坊主网的激活日期。
summary.en: The Ethereum Foundation announced on October 22 that core developers decided at All Core Developers Execution call #248 to postpone Glamsterdam's activation on the Hoodi testnet, cancelling the activation scheduled for October 26 at 17:42:48 UTC along with the planned 200-million-gas limit, with no replacement date set. The delay allows further investigation of how EIP-8037's gas repricing interacts with smart contracts already deployed on mainnet, after security firm ChainSecurity warned the changes could affect existing contracts. The postponement only rolls back Hoodi's future configuration, does not alter its chain history, and sets no mainnet activation date.

title.zh: 比特币再度跌破8万美元，美联储会议与AI股抛售打压风险偏好
title.en: Bitcoin slips below $80,000 again as Fed meeting and AI-stock selloff weigh on risk appetite

summary.zh: 比特币10月26日一度跌至约7.93万美元附近，随后回升至8万美元上下，以太币、XRP和Solana等主要代币也同步走弱。市场在10月27日至28日的美联储会议前削减风险敞口，同时投资者对人工智能领域巨额支出的疑虑拖累了科技股。分析人士指出，比特币仍低于约8.17万美元的50日均线，7.8万美元附近的支撑位受到关注。
summary.en: Bitcoin fell to about $79,300 on October 26 before recovering toward $80,000, while Ether, XRP and Solana also declined. Traders cut risk ahead of the Federal Reserve's October 27-28 meeting, and doubts over heavy AI spending weighed on technology shares. Bitcoin remained below its 50-day moving average near $81,700, with support near $78,000 in focus.

title.zh: 美国OCC呼吁社区银行申请成为支付稳定币发行方
title.en: US OCC urges community banks to apply to become payment stablecoin issuers

summary.zh: 在上周敲定《GENIUS法案》(GENIUS Act)实施细则后，美国货币监理署(OCC)于10月26日公开鼓励社区银行发展支付稳定币业务，并申请成为许可发行方或通过子公司发行。该法案将于2027年1月18日生效，对准备金、赎回、托管和风险管理作出规定。银行业团体此前对稳定币收益规则表示反对，并已就加密公司牌照问题起诉OCC。
summary.en: Days after finalizing its GENIUS Act implementation rules, the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency on October 26 encouraged community banks to develop payment stablecoin capabilities and apply to become permitted issuers, directly or via a subsidiary. The law takes effect on January 18, 2027, setting standards for reserves, redemption, custody and risk management. Banking groups have pushed back on the stablecoin yield rules and sued the OCC over crypto-company charters.

title.zh: 韩国考虑第四次推迟加密货币利得税，实施时间或延至2029年
title.en: South Korea weighs fourth delay of crypto gains tax, pushing it to 2029

summary.zh: 据韩国媒体报道，韩国政府正倾向于把原定2027年1月实施的加密货币利得税再度推迟至2029年，这将是该政策的第四次推迟。现行方案对年收益超过250万韩元的部分征收22%的税（含地方税），但由于美国要到2029年才开始参与经合组织(OECD)的加密资产报告框架(CARF)下的数据共享，官员担心本土交易所用户会承担不对称的税负。最终决定预计在11月底至12月初作出，仍需国会批准。
summary.en: South Korea's government is leaning toward delaying its crypto gains tax, due to start in January 2027, until 2029, in what would be a fourth postponement, Korean media reported. The plan would levy 22%, including local tax, on annual gains above 2.5 million won, but officials worry domestic-exchange users would bear an uneven burden because the US will not join OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework data sharing until 2029. A final decision is expected in late November or early December and would still need parliamentary approval.

title.zh: Solana代币化股票持有人数创历史新高，自8月以来增长约五倍
title.en: Solana tokenized-equity holders hit all-time high, up about fivefold since August

summary.zh: Solana网络上的代币化股票持有人数在10月26日达到约164万个地址，创历史新高，自8月以来增长约五倍，9月单月交易量约为44亿美元。这一增长与美国监管明确化及机构需求有关，8月3日至10月11日期间的激励计划向超过36万个钱包发放了约3100万美元的股票代币。不过该指标统计的是地址而非独立投资者，同一投资者使用多个钱包会被重复计算。
summary.en: The number of tokenized-equity holders on Solana reached about 1.64 million addresses on October 26, an all-time high and roughly a fivefold increase since August, with September trading volume of about $4.4 billion. The growth has been linked to US regulatory clarity and institutional demand, while incentive programs distributed about $31 million in stock tokens to over 360,000 wallets between August 3 and October 11. The metric counts addresses, not distinct investors, so one person using several wallets can appear more than once.

title.zh: Strive再购6182枚比特币，总持仓达4.3万枚
title.en: Strive buys 6,182 more Bitcoin, lifting treasury to 43,000 BTC

summary.zh: 纳斯达克上市公司Strive在10月26日提交的8-K文件(Form 8-K)中披露，于10月17日至23日以约每枚82732美元的均价购入6182枚比特币，总额约5.11亿美元，总持仓从36818枚增至4.3万枚。公司同期现金增至约5.04亿美元，并新设立了规模上限10亿美元的SATS优先股发行计划。按持仓规模，Strive已成为第四大公开上市的企业比特币持有方，仅次于Strategy、Metaplanet和Twenty One。
summary.en: Nasdaq-listed Strive disclosed in an October 26 Form 8-K that it bought 6,182 Bitcoin between October 17 and 23 at an average of about $82,732 per coin, roughly $511 million, lifting its holdings from 36,818 to 43,000 BTC. Cash rose to about $504.4 million over the same period, and the company set up a SATS preferred-stock sale program of up to $1 billion. The holdings rank Strive fourth among publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holders, behind Strategy, Metaplanet and Twenty One.

title.zh: 10月底最后一周代币解锁规模超7.3亿美元，CARDS、SUI与KMNO在列
title.en: Token unlocks worth over $730 million due in final week of October, including CARDS, SUI and KMNO

summary.zh: 10月最后一周的代币解锁总规模超过7.301亿美元，其中Collector Crypt(CARDS)将于10月29日解锁5926万枚（约1757万美元，占已释放供应量的9.60%），Kamino(KMNO)将于10月30日解锁约2.29亿枚（约969万美元），Sui(SUI)将于11月1日解锁1315万枚（约1211万美元）。这些解锁主要流向团队、早期贡献者、社区储备和投资者，Tokenomist仍将其标记为待验证，实际数量可能调整，短期波动风险值得关注。
summary.en: Token unlocks worth more than $730.1 million are scheduled for the final week of October. Collector Crypt (CARDS) unlocks 59.26 million tokens on October 29 (about $17.57 million, 9.60% of released supply), Kamino (KMNO) unlocks about 229.17 million on October 30 (about $9.69 million), and Sui (SUI) unlocks 13.15 million on November 1 (about $12.11 million). The tokens go mainly to teams, early contributors, community reserves and investors, and tracker Tokenomist still flags the amounts as pending verification, so short-term volatility is a risk to watch.

title.zh: 美国现货以太币ETF 10月净流出超11亿美元，机构需求持续降温
title.en: US spot Ether ETFs pass $1.1 billion in October outflows as institutional demand cools

summary.zh: 美国现货以太币ETF(Spot Ether ETF)在10月迄今的净流出已超过11亿美元，其中上周为连续第四周净流出，约2.21亿美元。10月23日虽录得小幅净流入约430万美元，但过去21个交易日的净流出仍高达约11.3亿美元，基金总资产降至约146亿美元附近。以太币价格在约2320美元附近承压，市场同时等待美联储会议结果和以太坊Glamsterdam升级测试的下一步进展。
summary.en: US spot Ether ETFs have recorded more than $1.1 billion in net outflows so far in October, including a fourth consecutive weekly outflow of about $221 million last week. A small $4.3 million net inflow on October 23 did not change the trend: roughly $1.13 billion left over the previous 21 trading days, leaving total assets near $14.6 billion. Ether traded near $2,320 under pressure as markets awaited the Federal Reserve meeting and the next step in testing Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade.

title.zh: Solana交易机器人Bloom用户钱包被盗约95万美元，官方承诺全额赔付
title.en: Solana trading bot Bloom users lose about $950,000 in wallet drain; full reimbursement promised

summary.zh: 基于Solana的Telegram交易机器人Bloom Trading在10月26日遭遇钱包盗取事件，9名用户的49个钱包共损失约9408枚SOL，价值约95万美元，最大单笔损失约1636枚SOL。Bloom表示正在调查疑似第三方入侵，已暂停部分服务，并承诺向用户指定的新安全钱包全额赔付。此次事件再次凸显托管式交易机器人由平台生成并持有用户私钥所带来的风险。
summary.en: Solana-based Telegram trading bot Bloom Trading suffered a wallet drain on October 26, with 49 wallets belonging to nine users losing about 9,408 SOL, worth roughly $950,000; the largest single loss was about 1,636 SOL. Bloom said it is investigating a suspected third-party compromise, has paused some services, and plans to fully reimburse affected users to new secure wallets they designate. The incident highlights the risk of custodial trading bots, where the platform generates and holds users' private keys.

title.zh: Initia公布被盗根因：MoveVM脚本缓存漏洞，USDC跨链储备一度仅剩63美元
title.en: Initia names MoveVM script-caching bug as exploit root cause; USDC bridge reserve fell to $63

summary.zh: Initia在10月24日的更新中将10月23日的攻击归因于MoveVM脚本缓存（Script Caching）漏洞，攻击者借此绕过安全检查、伪造虚拟机状态，凭空记入无抵押的WETH、iUSD与USDC余额，并通过跨链桥转出约270万美元资产。链上分析显示，USDC跨链储备在攻击期间从约100万美元骤降至63美元，导致普通用户的赎回接连失败；截至10月24日，Initia主网与Rollup仍处于停摆，修复与审计尚需数日，重启时间与赔付方案均未公布。
summary.en: Initia's October 24 update attributed the October 23 attack to a MoveVM script-caching bug that let the attacker bypass security checks and spoof virtual-machine state, crediting itself with unbacked WETH, iUSD and USDC balances and bridging out about $2.7 million. On-chain analysis showed the USDC bridge reserve plunging from about $1 million to $63 during the attack, causing ordinary withdrawal attempts to fail. As of October 24, Initia's mainnet and rollups remained halted, with a fix and audit still days away and no restart date or compensation plan announced.

title.zh: 比特币周末一度跌破8万美元，逾4亿美元多头仓位遭清算，随后回升至8.05万美元附近
title.en: Bitcoin briefly fell below $80,000 over the weekend, liquidating over $400M in longs, then recovered near $80,500

summary.zh: 受中东地缘紧张消息影响，比特币在10月24日（周六）一度跌破8万美元，触及约79280美元的一个多月低点，短短四小时内逾4亿美元杠杆多头仓位（Long Positions）被清算。美国现货ETF（Spot ETF）在周四与周五合计净流出约7.735亿美元，投资者要到周一才能在ETF市场操作。比特币在10月25日（周日）回升至约80500美元附近，仍处于一个多月来的低位区间，加密恐惧与贪婪指数（Crypto Fear & Greed Index）为40，处于“恐惧”区域。
summary.en: Amid reports of Middle East tensions, Bitcoin briefly fell below $80,000 on Saturday, October 24, touching a more-than-one-month low near $79,280, with over $400 million in leveraged long positions liquidated within four hours. US spot ETFs recorded combined net outflows of about $773.5 million on Thursday and Friday, leaving ETF investors unable to trade until Monday. Bitcoin recovered to around $80,500 on Sunday, October 25, still near its weakest levels in over a month, while the Crypto Fear & Greed Index sat at 40, in 'Fear' territory.

title.zh: Kraken撤回门罗币用户问卷，联合CEO确认XMR继续上架
title.en: Kraken withdraws Monero customer questionnaires; co-CEO confirms XMR stays listed

summary.zh: Kraken联合首席执行官Arjun Sethi于10月23日表示，交易所此前向部分门罗币（Monero, XMR）用户发送的问卷是错误的，现已撤回，受影响客户无需回复。问卷曾要求用户提供雇主信息、资金来源以及提币后的用途，Sethi称没有任何规则要求这些信息，资金来源是合理的合规问题，但用户提币后的用途不在交易所的监管范围之内。Kraken同时确认XMR继续上架、可正常交易与提币，但欧洲经济区、英国、加拿大与澳大利亚等地的原有交易限制不变。
summary.en: Kraken co-CEO Arjun Sethi said on October 23 that questionnaires previously sent to some Monero (XMR) customers were a mistake and have been withdrawn, with affected clients told nothing is required of them. The emails had asked for employer details, the source of funds and what customers planned to do with withdrawn coins; Sethi said no rule required the questions, arguing that the source of funds is a fair compliance question but post-withdrawal use is not the exchange's concern. Kraken confirmed XMR stays listed and available for trading and withdrawal, while existing restrictions in the European Economic Area, the UK, Canada and Australia remain in place.

title.zh: Strategy一周回购STRC花掉1.931亿美元，约为同期买入比特币支出的8.7倍
title.en: Strategy spent $193.1M buying back STRC in one week, about 8.7 times what it spent buying Bitcoin

summary.zh: 根据Strategy于10月19日提交的监管文件，公司在10月12日至18日当周以2210万美元买入267枚比特币（Bitcoin），均价82900美元，持仓增至848517枚；但同期以1.931亿美元回购了约194万股STRC优先股（Preferred Stock），约为买币支出的8.7倍，回购资金全部来自公司现金。Strategy董事会同时将数字信用证券回购授权上限从20亿美元提高至30亿美元，约11.6亿美元额度尚未使用；分析机构Clear Street与Cantor Fitzgerald随后分别将目标价上调至211美元与208美元。
summary.en: According to Strategy's regulatory filing dated October 19, the company bought 267 Bitcoin for $22.1 million during the week of October 12-18 at an average price of $82,900, lifting holdings to 848,517 BTC; but it spent $193.1 million repurchasing about 1.94 million STRC preferred shares in the same week, roughly 8.7 times its Bitcoin spending, funded entirely from cash. Strategy's board also raised its digital credit securities repurchase authorization from $2 billion to $3 billion, with about $1.16 billion still untapped, while analysts Clear Street and Cantor Fitzgerald raised their price targets to $211 and $208 respectively.

title.zh: 以太坊研究人员提交EIP-8453，拟将最终确认时间从约16分钟缩短至4分钟
title.en: Ethereum researchers file EIP-8453 to cut finality from about 16 minutes to roughly four

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会研究员Ben Edgington于10月21日在以太坊改进提案（Ethereum Improvement Proposal, EIP）仓库提交了“解耦共识”（Decoupled Consensus）草案，编号EIP-8453，目标是将交易的最终确认（Finality）时间从约16分钟缩短至约4分钟。该草案将验证者的选块投票与最终确认投票拆分，让确认投票按独立的、可以逐步加快的节奏进行；更快的确认可减少跨链桥与快速转账服务为等待结算而垫付的资金，草案示例称每小时转移100万美元的服务在途资金将从约26.7万美元降至约6.7万美元。草案同时为未来的抗量子签名过渡打基础，但尚无激活时间表，实施需要共识层硬分叉（Hard Fork）。
summary.en: Ethereum Foundation researcher Ben Edgington filed a 'Decoupled Consensus' draft in the Ethereum Improvement Proposals repository on October 21, numbered EIP-8453, aiming to cut transaction finality from about 16 minutes to roughly four. The draft separates validators' block-selection votes from finality votes, letting finality votes run on their own schedule that can be tightened over time; faster finality would reduce the capital bridges and fast-transfer services must front while awaiting settlement, with the draft's example putting idle capital for a service moving $1 million an hour at about $267,000 today versus $67,000 at four minutes. The draft also lays groundwork for a future post-quantum signature transition, but has no activation date and would require a consensus-layer hard fork.

title.zh: 爱尔兰央行对Coinbase爱尔兰子公司处以325万欧元罚款，涉客户资金保护违规
title.en: Central Bank of Ireland fines Coinbase Ireland €3.25M over customer-fund safeguarding breaches

summary.zh: 爱尔兰央行于10月21日与Coinbase爱尔兰子公司（Coinbase Ireland Limited）达成和解，对其处以3252618欧元罚款并给予正式训诫，原因是该电子货币机构在2020年11月至2025年8月期间违反了客户资金保护（Safeguarding）与外包规则。央行认定，该公司过度依赖美国母公司执行资金保护流程、缺乏本地专业能力进行监督，导致指定保护账户长期资金不足，且未及时向监管机构报告资金保护模式的重大变化。原定罚款4646597欧元，和解折扣30%后降至3252618欧元，罚款须经爱尔兰高等法院确认后生效；Coinbase表示没有客户遭受资金损失或无法取用资金。
summary.en: The Central Bank of Ireland reached a settlement on October 21 with Coinbase Ireland Limited, imposing a €3,252,618 penalty and a formal reprimand after finding the e-money firm breached customer-fund safeguarding and outsourcing rules between November 2020 and August 2025. The regulator found the firm relied too heavily on its US parent to run safeguarding processes, lacked the local expertise to oversee them, left its designated safeguarding account underfunded for extended periods, and failed to notify the regulator of material changes to its safeguarding model. The penalty was set at €4,646,597 before a 30% settlement discount, and takes effect only once Ireland's High Court confirms it; Coinbase said no customer suffered a financial loss or lost access to funds.

title.zh: 摩根大通将两只代币化货币市场基金MONY与JLTXX扩展至Solana
title.en: JPMorgan brings tokenized money market funds MONY and JLTXX to Solana

summary.zh: 摩根大通资产管理公司于10月22日宣布，将两只代币化货币市场基金（Tokenized Money Market Fund）——My OnChain Net Yield Fund（MONY）与JPMorgan OnChain Liquidity-Token Money Market Fund（JLTXX）扩展至Solana网络，供符合条件的美国投资者通过Morgan Money平台申购与赎回，并直接在投资者自己的区块链地址上收到基金份额代币。两只基金此前均已在以太坊（Ethereum）上线，其中JLTXX截至9月30日的资产规模为6.2848亿美元，七日年化收益率（SEC Yield）为3.79%。摩根大通表示，客户在多个网络上运作，其流动性也应如此，此举是现有产品的多链扩展，而非新设基金。
summary.en: JPMorgan Asset Management announced on October 22 that its two tokenized money market funds — My OnChain Net Yield Fund (MONY) and JPMorgan OnChain Liquidity-Token Money Market Fund (JLTXX) — are now available on Solana, letting eligible US investors subscribe and redeem through the Morgan Money platform and receive fund tokens directly at their own blockchain addresses. Both funds previously launched on Ethereum; JLTXX held $628.48 million in assets as of September 30, with a 3.79% seven-day SEC yield. JPMorgan said clients operate across more than one network and their liquidity should too, framing the move as a multichain extension of existing products rather than a new fund.

title.zh: Evernorth向SEC提交招股文件，认股权证全部行权可募资约1.322亿美元增持XRP
title.en: Evernorth files SEC prospectus; full warrant exercise could raise about $132.2M for XRP treasury

summary.zh: 纳斯达克上市的XRP金库公司Evernorth Holdings于10月19日向美国证券交易委员会（Securities and Exchange Commission, SEC）提交最终招股文件，登记11499992股A类普通股，供公开认股权证（Public Warrants）持有人按每股11.50美元行权；若全部行权，公司可募资约1.322亿美元，资金按其策略将用于增持XRP。文件同时披露，XRP价格在合并协议签署日至交易完成日之间下跌约40%，导致早期投资者的附加股份调整机制未能触发；公司目前持有约4.73亿枚XRP，价值约6.38亿美元，另有约3亿美元现金。招股登记本身不保证行权或买入，实际募资取决于持有人决定与市场波动。
summary.en: Nasdaq-listed XRP treasury company Evernorth Holdings filed a final prospectus with the US Securities and Exchange Commission on October 19, registering 11,499,992 Class A shares issuable when holders of its public warrants exercise at $11.50 per share; full exercise would raise about $132.2 million, which the company's strategy points toward buying more XRP. The filing also disclosed that XRP fell roughly 40% between the signing of its merger agreement and closing, so a built-in adjustment mechanism for early investors was not triggered; the company currently holds about 473 million XRP worth roughly $638 million plus about $300 million in cash. Registration alone guarantees no exercise or purchase, with actual proceeds depending on warrant holders' decisions and market conditions.

title.zh: 硬件钱包厂商Keystone披露官网数据泄露，助记词与私钥未受影响
title.en: Keystone discloses website data breach; seed phrases and private keys unaffected

summary.zh: 硬件钱包厂商Keystone于10月24日披露，其官网在10月20日遭到未授权访问，经与Shopify核查应用程序接口（Application Programming Interface, API）活动后于10月23日确认，第三方获取了客户姓名、联系方式、收货地址及订单详情。公司表示支付卡与银行信息、助记词（Seed Phrase）、私钥（Private Key）及钱包密码均未泄露，已封堵访问入口、修复漏洞并开始邮件通知受影响客户。Keystone同时警告，用户须警惕冒充官方索要退款或换机、诱导透露助记词的诈骗。
summary.en: Hardware wallet maker Keystone disclosed on October 24 that unauthorized access to its official website on October 20 exposed customer names, contact details, shipping addresses and order details, confirmed on October 23 after reviewing Shopify API activity. The company said payment card and bank details, seed phrases, private keys and wallet passwords were not compromised, and that it has blocked the access, fixed the vulnerability and begun emailing affected customers. Keystone warned users to watch for impostors offering refunds or replacement devices to trick them into revealing recovery phrases.

title.zh: 以太坊质押量创纪录达4380万枚，占供应量约36%，收益率降至2.63%
title.en: Ethereum staking hits record 43.8M ETH, about 36% of supply, as yield slips to 2.63%

summary.zh: Bitwise首份质押报告显示，以太坊质押量已达约4380万枚ETH，占总供应量近36%，创历史新高，第三季度新增质押近200万枚，机构通过质押型交易所交易产品（Exchange-Traded Product, ETP）与企业财库持续加仓。尽管年化质押收益率已从2.81%降至2.63%，仍有约138万枚ETH排队等待进入质押，预估等待时间超过24天。报告指出，随着质押比例逼近50%，EIP-8361等调整发行机制的提案值得关注。
summary.en: Bitwise's first staking report shows about 43.8 million ETH, nearly 36% of supply, now staked on Ethereum, a record, with almost 2 million ETH added in the third quarter as institutions contributed through staking ETPs and corporate treasuries. Although the annualized staking yield has fallen from 2.81% to 2.63%, about 1.38 million ETH remains queued to enter staking, with an estimated wait of more than 24 days. The report flags proposals such as EIP-8361 to adjust issuance as the staking ratio approaches 50%.

title.zh: 比特币周六回落至约80400美元，重回9月水平
title.en: Bitcoin slips back toward $80,400 on Saturday, returning to September levels

summary.zh: 比特币在10月24日周六回落至约80400美元附近，较24小时前下跌约1%，回到了9月以来首次跌破的80000美元关口附近，此前一周内冲高至近85000美元后未能守住涨幅。本轮回调伴随美国现货比特币交易所交易基金（Spot ETF）的资金流出，周四单日净流出逾6.35亿美元，几乎追平截至10月9日当周的总流出额。市场情绪转弱之际，交易员正关注下周美联储政策会议带来的下一步信号。
summary.en: Bitcoin fell to about $80,400 on Saturday, October 24, down roughly 1% over 24 hours and back near the $80,000 level it last traded in September, after failing to hold a rally toward $85,000 earlier in the week. The pullback came alongside outflows from U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs, which lost more than $635 million on Thursday alone, nearly matching the total outflow for the week ended October 9. With sentiment weakening, traders are watching next week's Federal Reserve policy meeting for the next signal.

title.zh: 汇丰港元稳定币RedCoin登陆PayMe，首批覆盖330万用户
title.en: HSBC's Hong Kong dollar stablecoin RedCoin rolls out on PayMe to 3.3 million users

summary.zh: 汇丰银行于10月23日开始向香港支付应用PayMe的逾330万用户分阶段推出首款港元稳定币RedCoin（RCHKD），首阶段支持用户间转账及在逾10万家商户付款，并承诺按1比1兑换港元。RedCoin在香港《稳定币条例》框架下发行，由汇丰持有的稳定币发行人牌照（FRS02）覆盖，储备为隔离的高质量流动资产，且本身不支付利息。汇丰计划在2026年底前将该代币接入香港汇丰流动理财应用，用于认购代币化投资产品，起投额低至100港元。
summary.en: HSBC began rolling out RedCoin (RCHKD), its first Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, to more than 3.3 million PayMe users in Hong Kong on October 23, with the first phase covering peer-to-peer transfers and payments at over 100,000 merchants and one-to-one redemption in Hong Kong dollars. Issued under Hong Kong's Stablecoins Ordinance under HSBC's issuer licence FRS02, RedCoin is backed by segregated, high-quality liquid assets and pays no interest. HSBC plans to bring the token into its Hong Kong mobile banking app by the end of 2026 for tokenized investment subscriptions starting at HK$100.

title.zh: 加密ETF一周收绿：比特币基金净流入约3.09亿美元，以太坊基金流出2.21亿美元
title.en: Crypto ETFs end week in green as Bitcoin funds gain about $309M and Ether funds lose $221M

summary.zh: 尽管周五合计净流出1.3254亿美元，美国加密交易所交易基金（ETF）一周仍以8764万美元净流入收官，扭转了此前一周6.009亿美元净流出的局面。本周比特币基金净流入约3.09亿美元，其中贝莱德IBIT一周吸金5.6567亿美元，而以太坊基金则净流出2.2066亿美元，贝莱德ETHA流出2.3319亿美元。资金在周内剧烈摇摆：周一至周三合计流入后，周四单日流出7.4495亿美元，凸显机构需求仍不稳定。
summary.en: U.S. crypto ETFs ended the week $87.64 million in net inflows despite $132.54 million of outflows on Friday, reversing the previous week's $600.9 million net outflow. Bitcoin funds drew about $309 million over the week, with BlackRock's IBIT attracting $565.67 million, while Ethereum funds lost $220.66 million, including $233.19 million from BlackRock's ETHA. Flows swung sharply during the week, with strong inflows Monday through Wednesday followed by $744.95 million in outflows on Thursday, underscoring still-unstable institutional demand.

title.zh: Initia遭无抵押增发攻击损失约270万美元，L1与Rollup全网暂停
title.en: Initia halts L1 and rollups after unauthorized minting exploit drains about $2.7M

summary.zh: 模块化公链Initia于10月23日15时41分（协调世界时，UTC）暂停其一层网络（Layer 1, L1）及关联Rollup，此前攻击者利用Move虚拟机（MoveVM）漏洞无抵押增发代币并通过跨链桥转移资产，初步估计损失约270万美元。据安全研究机构D2 Finance分析，攻击者增发了约200万枚无抵押的AUSD，并跨链提取约140万枚AUSD、105枚ETH及108万枚USDC，最终整合为约1135.5枚ETH。Initia表示正与安全研究人员、验证者及交易所合作评估影响，重启时间尚未公布。
summary.en: Modular blockchain Initia halted its layer-1 network and connected rollups at 15:41 UTC on October 23 after an attacker exploited a MoveVM flaw to mint tokens without backing and move assets across bridges, with preliminary losses estimated at about $2.7 million. Security firm D2 Finance reported the attacker minted about 2 million unbacked AUSD and withdrew roughly 1.4 million AUSD, 105 ETH and 1.08 million USDC to Ethereum, consolidating them into about 1,135.5 ETH. Initia said it is working with security researchers, validators and exchanges to assess the impact, with no restart timeline announced.

title.zh: Solana提出Quantumglow抗量子方案，为Alpenglow共识抵御未来量子攻击
title.en: Solana pitches Quantumglow to shield Alpenglow consensus from future quantum attacks

summary.zh: Solana开发者于10月22日介绍了Quantumglow方案，这是一项针对Alpenglow共识机制的抗量子（Post-Quantum）改造设想，旨在抵御量子计算对验证者签名的潜在威胁，同时保留约150毫秒的快速最终性。该方案基于Anza于7月30日发表的研究，核心包括基于哈希的Ax（Alpenglow XMSS）签名方案与分布式 quorum 签名设计，验证者将预先交换并缓存一次性公钥材料以降低通信开销。开发者强调，Quantumglow目前仅为研究提案，尚未公布实施时间表，也未对应专门的Solana改进提案（Solana Improvement Document, SIMD）。
summary.en: Solana developers presented Quantumglow on October 22, a proposed post-quantum adaptation of the Alpenglow consensus mechanism designed to protect validator signatures against future quantum computing threats while preserving roughly 150-millisecond finality. Based on research Anza published on July 30, the design centers on the hash-based Ax (Alpenglow XMSS) signature scheme and a distributed quorum signature design, with validators pre-exchanging and caching one-time public-key material to reduce communication overhead. Developers stressed Quantumglow is only a research proposal, with no implementation timeline and no dedicated Solana Improvement Document (SIMD) announced.

title.zh: SEC加密资产新规征求意见截止后，银行与行业团体立场分裂
title.en: Banks and industry groups split over SEC crypto rules as comment window closes

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会（Securities and Exchange Commission, SEC）拟议的《加密资产监管条例》（Regulation Crypto Assets）征求意见期于10月20日截止，暴露出行业与银行业之间的明显分歧。该提案允许符合条件的加密项目在四年内融资最高500万美元或每年最高7500万美元而无需注册，区块链协会（Blockchain Association）则呼吁将上限提高至1000万美元与1.5亿美元，并明确代币何时不再属于投资合同。银行业团体则警告，更宽松的发行规则可能加速稳定币采用并分流存款，对金融稳定构成风险。
summary.en: The comment period for the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's proposed Regulation Crypto Assets closed on October 20, exposing a sharp split between the crypto industry and banks. The proposal would let qualifying crypto projects raise up to $5 million over four years or $75 million annually without registering their offerings, while the Blockchain Association urged raising the caps to $10 million and $150 million and clarifying when tokens cease to be investment contracts. Banking groups warned that easier issuance could accelerate stablecoin adoption and drain deposits, posing financial-stability risks.

title.zh: 贝莱德申请第三只比特币ETF PBIT，以期权换取约10%的下跌缓冲
title.en: BlackRock files for third Bitcoin ETF PBIT, trading capped upside for about 10% downside cushion

summary.zh: 贝莱德于10月19日向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交了iShares比特币管理保护ETF（iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF，代码PBIT）的初步招募说明书，这是其第三只比特币相关ETF。该基金不直接持有比特币或比特币交易所交易产品（ETP），而是通过与IBIT挂钩的期权组合获取敞口：三档交错的看涨期权价差（Call Spread）各以约90%的参考价作为保护起点，目标是在支付费用前缓冲约10%的下跌，同时以卖出高行权价看涨期权换取成本并封顶上涨收益。PBIT尚未生效交易，管理费、上市交易所及发行日期均未披露。
summary.en: BlackRock filed a preliminary prospectus with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on October 19 for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF (ticker PBIT), its third Bitcoin-linked ETF. The fund would not hold bitcoin or bitcoin ETPs directly, instead gaining exposure through options tied to IBIT: three overlapping call-spread tranches, each starting protection at about 90% of the reference value to cushion roughly 10% of declines before fees, while sold higher-strike calls fund the protection and cap upside. PBIT is not yet effective for trading, with its fee, listing exchange and launch date undisclosed.

title.zh: Cysic攻击者向Tornado Cash转移约74.4万美元，不理会10%白帽赏金
title.en: Cysic exploiter moves ~$744K to Tornado Cash, shrugging off 10% white-hat bounty

summary.zh: 与Cysic跨链桥漏洞利用相关的地址向混币器Tornado Cash（龙卷风现金）存入了300枚ETH和30.4枚BNB，合计约74.4万美元，链上安全公司PeckShield对此进行了标记。该攻击者此前在BNB智能链（BNB Smart Chain）上未经授权铸造了1000万枚CYS代币，而Cysic基金会日前向其开出10%赏金，换取返还约90%的ETH收益。攻击者以太坊钱包中目前仅剩约45美元的ETH，资金追回前景黯淡。
summary.en: Addresses tied to the Cysic bridge exploit deposited 300 ETH and 30.4 BNB, worth about $744,000, into the mixer Tornado Cash, blockchain security firm PeckShield flagged. The attacker had previously minted 10 million CYS tokens on BNB Smart Chain without authorization, and the Cysic Foundation had offered a 10% bounty in exchange for the return of roughly 90% of the identified ETH proceeds. The attacker's Ethereum wallet now holds only about $45 in ETH, dimming recovery prospects.

title.zh: 美国SEC将证券代币化列入2027财年检查重点，加密资产连续第二年缺席
title.en: US SEC adds tokenization to FY2027 exam priorities; crypto absent for second straight year

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）检查部门发布2027财年检查重点，将证券代币化（tokenization）列为关键市场基础设施与清算机构检查的高风险领域，并与超智能（SI）、延长交易时段和量子计算（quantum computing）并列。报告20页全文未提及crypto或数字资产，这也是加密资产连续第二年未被单列为检查类别。检查重点只是合规审查指南，不构成新规，但表明传统金融向代币化基础设施演进已进入监管视野。
summary.en: The SEC's Division of Examinations released its fiscal 2027 examination priorities, naming tokenization of securities a high-risk area for examinations of critical market infrastructure and clearing agencies, alongside super intelligence (SI), extended trading hours and quantum computing. The 20-page report makes no mention of crypto or digital assets, marking the second consecutive year crypto is absent as a standalone examination category. The priorities guide compliance reviews rather than creating new rules, but signal that TradFi's move toward tokenized infrastructure is now on the regulator's radar.

title.zh: 比特币回落至8.15万美元附近考验8万美元关口，十月恐录得7月以来首月下跌
title.en: Bitcoin retreats toward $81,500 as $80K support is tested; October heads for first monthly loss since July

summary.zh: 比特币周五跌回约8.15万美元，24小时跌幅约3%，最低触及约8.08万美元，距离关键的8万美元心理关口仅一步之遥。抛售并非加密市场原生因素：中东紧张局势推高油价（布伦特原油突破116美元创半年新高），加上科技股暴跌（纳斯达克指数周四下挫2.6%）拖累整体风险资产，投机资金率先从高贝塔资产撤出。若8万美元失守，本月恐录得7月以来的首次月度下跌。
summary.en: Bitcoin slid back to around $81,500 on Friday, down about 3% in 24 hours with a session low near $80,800, leaving it within reach of the key $80,000 psychological level. The selloff was not crypto-native: escalating Middle East tensions pushed Brent crude above $116 for a six-month high, while a tech-stock rout (the Nasdaq Composite fell 2.6% on Thursday) dragged risk assets lower, with speculative capital retreating from high-beta assets first. A decisive close below $80,000 would confirm October's first monthly loss since July.

title.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF周四净流出6.36亿美元，创6月以来最大单日流出
title.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs post $636M Thursday outflows, largest single-day withdrawal since June

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF（Spot Bitcoin ETF）周四录得约6.356亿美元净流出，为6月以来最大单日流出，扭转了此前三日的净流入势头。贝莱德（BlackRock）IBIT流出2.541亿美元领衔，富达（Fidelity）FBTC流出2.175亿美元，ARKB流出1.094亿美元；摩根士丹利（Morgan Stanley）的MSBT逆势小幅流入230万美元。尽管单日大幅回吐，本周ETF资金流仍为净流入约4.43亿美元，终结了此前连续两周的净流出。
summary.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded about $635.6 million in net outflows on Thursday, the largest single-day withdrawal since June, reversing a three-day inflow streak. BlackRock's IBIT led with $254.1 million in outflows, followed by Fidelity's FBTC at $217.5 million and ARKB at $109.4 million; Morgan Stanley's MSBT bucked the trend with a $2.3 million inflow. Despite the one-day giveback, weekly ETF flows remain positive at about $442.7 million, ending two consecutive weeks of net outflows.

title.zh: 现货以太币ETF周四净流出1.106亿美元，重返流出通道
title.en: Spot Ether ETFs return to outflows with $110.6M Thursday redemptions

summary.zh: 美国现货以太币ETF（Spot Ether ETF）周四净流出1.106亿美元，其中贝莱德（BlackRock）ETHA流出7545万美元，在仅短暂回补一天后重返净流出。Solana和Hyperliquid相关ETF当日同样净流出，仅XRP基金逆势小幅流入360万美元。十月以来以太币ETF累计净流出已达约10.8亿美元，为年内最大单月流出，机构需求疲弱仍是ETH价格承压的重要因素。
summary.en: US spot Ether ETFs recorded $110.6 million in net outflows on Thursday, with BlackRock's ETHA accounting for $75.45 million, returning to redemptions after just one day of inflows. Solana and Hyperliquid ETFs also saw net outflows that day, while XRP funds were the lone outlier with a $3.6 million inflow. October net outflows from Ether ETFs have reached about $1.08 billion, the largest monthly withdrawal of the year, as weak institutional demand keeps weighing on ETH.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级延期：Hoodi测试网10月26日激活取消，研究EIP-8037安全风险
title.en: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam: Oct 26 Hoodi testnet activation canceled over EIP-8037 security review

summary.zh: 以太坊核心开发者在第248次执行层共识电话会议（ACDE #248）上决定推迟Glamsterdam升级在Hoodi测试网的激活，原定于10月26日17:42:48 UTC的激活已被取消，暂无新的时间表。推迟的原因是安全公司ChainSecurity标记了13个已部署合约，其行为可能因EIP-8037的gas计量方式变更而改变，开发者需要更多时间研究其与现有主网合约的交互。随升级一同推迟的还有Hoodi的区块gas上限提升至2亿的计划。
summary.en: Ethereum core developers decided on the ACDE #248 call to delay the Glamsterdam upgrade's activation on the Hoodi testnet, canceling the October 26 activation scheduled for 17:42:48 UTC, with no replacement date set. The delay stems from security firm ChainSecurity flagging 13 deployed contracts whose behavior could change under EIP-8037's gas-accounting changes, and developers want more time to study interactions with existing mainnet contracts. The planned Hoodi gas-limit increase to 200 million is postponed along with the upgrade.

title.zh: Glassnode：比特币国库公司月度增持不足2024年峰值的10%，平均持仓成本约8.02万美元
title.en: Glassnode: Bitcoin treasury companies' monthly buying under 10% of 2024 peak; avg cost ~$80,200

summary.zh: Glassnode 10月21日发布的链上周报显示，其追踪的比特币国库公司平均持仓成本约为8.02万美元，比特币自9月18日以来每日收盘价均高于该水平。尽管整体处于盈利状态，公司增持并未随价格回升而恢复：自6月以来每月新增持仓均不足2024年11月峰值的10%。Strategy上周（10月12-18日）仅增持267枚BTC，均价约8.29万美元，当前共持有848,517枚，均价约7.54万美元。
summary.en: Glassnode's October 21 Week Onchain report estimates the average acquisition cost of its tracked Bitcoin treasury-company cohort at about $80,200, with Bitcoin's daily close above that level every day since September 18. Despite being in profit overall, corporate buying has not recovered with the price rebound: every monthly addition since June has stayed below 10% of the November 2024 peak. Strategy added just 267 BTC during October 12-18 at an average of about $82,900, holding 848,517 BTC at an average purchase price of about $75,446.

title.zh: Bitmine再质押15.97万枚ETH（约3.9亿美元），质押份额达国库86.5%
title.en: Bitmine stakes another 159,728 ETH (~$390M), pushing staked share to 86.5% of treasury

summary.zh: 由Tom Lee担任董事长的Bitmine于10月21日再质押159,728枚ETH（约3.906亿美元），累计质押量达到约523万枚ETH，价值约127.8亿美元，占其约604万枚ETH国库的86.5%。其持仓已占ETH流通供应量的约4.9%，距离Lee设定的5%供应量硬顶仅差约6.35万枚。Bitmine未使用看跌或对冲头寸，大规模质押既赚取网络收益，也从可交易流通盘中锁定了大量ETH。
summary.en: Tom Lee-chaired Bitmine staked another 159,728 ETH (about $390.6 million) on October 21, taking total staked holdings to roughly 5.23 million ETH, worth about $12.78 billion, or 86.5% of its approximately 6.04 million ETH treasury. Its holdings now represent about 4.9% of ETH's circulating supply, leaving it roughly 63,500 ETH short of Lee's self-imposed 5% supply hard cap. The large-scale staking earns network yield while locking a significant share of ETH out of the tradable float.

title.zh: 印度交易所CoinDCX被指出现约1600万美元可疑转账，官方否认遭新攻击
title.en: CoinDCX faces $16M suspicious-transfer claims; exchange denies new breach

summary.zh: 区块链调查员Darcy于10月22日标记了与印度交易所CoinDCX相关地址约1600万美元（约1599万USDT与5783枚TRX）的可疑转账，资金流向TRON网络单一地址后被分散至多个钱包。多名链上侦探对交易所的说法提出质疑，而CoinDCX联合创始人Sumit Gupta否认发生新的安全事件，称相关地址在2025年7月事件中已被攻破、不属于交易所当前运营。目前转账本身尚未被证实为新的黑客攻击。
summary.en: Blockchain investigator Darcy flagged about $16 million in suspicious transfers (roughly 15.99M USDT and 5,783 TRX) from addresses associated with Indian exchange CoinDCX on Oct 22, with funds moving to a single TRON address before being split across wallets. Several on-chain sleuths questioned the exchange's account, while co-founder Sumit Gupta denied a new security breach, saying the flagged addresses were compromised in the July 2025 incident and are not part of current operations. The transfers alone have not been confirmed as a new hack.

title.zh: 以太坊ETF结束连续流出转为净流入，但十月累计仍大幅失血
title.en: Ether ETFs end outflow streak with modest inflows; October remains deep in the red

summary.zh: 美国现货以太坊ETF在10月21日录得约1500万美元净流入，结束了10月14-20日连续五个交易日、合计约3.89亿美元的资金流出。其中灰度以太坊迷你信托（Ethereum Mini Trust）与富达FETH领涨，而贝莱德ETHA仍录得约2930万美元赎回。尽管单日转正，十月累计仍为净流出，机构需求尚未实质恢复。
summary.en: US spot Ethereum ETFs recorded about $15 million of net inflows on Oct 21, ending a five-session outflow streak that drained roughly $389 million from Oct 14 to 20. Grayscale's Ethereum Mini Trust and Fidelity's FETH led the inflows, while BlackRock's ETHA saw another $29.3 million in redemptions. Despite the single-day rebound, October remains a net-outflow month for the category.

title.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF三日净流入10.8亿美元，十月资金流转正
title.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs pull $1.08B over three days as October flows turn positive

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF在10月19-21日连续三个交易日合计净流入约10.8亿美元，其中10月21日单日净流入5.28亿美元，贝莱德IBIT（2.35亿美元）与富达FBTC（约2.13亿美元）贡献了大部分。十月累计净流入回到约4.61亿美元，扭转此前两周连续赎回的局面。同日以太坊ETF结束连续流出，Solana ETF也终结了13连流出。
summary.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew roughly $1.08 billion over three consecutive sessions from Oct 19 to 21, with $528 million on Oct 21 alone, led by BlackRock's IBIT ($235M) and Fidelity's FBTC (~$213M). October's cumulative flows turned positive at about $461 million after two weeks of withdrawals. Ether ETFs also ended their outflow streak on the same day, while Solana ETFs snapped a 13-day streak of outflows.

title.zh: 比特币冲高8.5万美元后回落至8.2万美元附近，跟踪AI股抛售
title.en: Bitcoin reverses after approaching $85,000, tracking AI-stock selloff

summary.zh: 比特币在10月22日亚洲时段自前一交易日8.48万美元高点回落约2.2%，交投于8.2万-8.3万美元区间，回吐前一日涨幅。市场将此轮回落归因于AI概念股抛售引发的避险情绪，纳斯达克期货走弱拖累风险资产，加密相关股票跌幅更大。尽管价格承压，现货比特币ETF的机构资金流入仍在延续。
summary.en: Bitcoin fell about 2.2% in Asian trading on Oct 22, retreating to the $82,000-$83,000 range after reaching as high as $84,835 in the previous session. The pullback tracked weakness in Nasdaq futures as renewed AI-trade concerns dampened risk appetite, with crypto-related equities falling harder. Institutional demand via spot Bitcoin ETFs continued despite the price pressure.

title.zh: Solana完成Alpenglow主网升级，交易最终确认缩短至约0.15秒
title.en: Solana completes Alpenglow mainnet upgrade, cutting finality to ~0.15 seconds

summary.zh: Solana于10月21日完成Alpenglow共识升级的主网部署，将交易最终确认时间从约12.8秒缩短至约0.15秒（150毫秒）。升级以Votor协议取代原有的TowerBFT投票机制，验证者通过链下直接通信与BLS签名聚合（BLS signature aggregation）达成共识，不再将每笔投票写入链上。此次升级被视为Solana自2020年上线以来最大规模的共识机制改造。
summary.en: Solana completed the Alpenglow consensus upgrade on mainnet on Oct 21, reducing transaction finality from about 12.8 seconds to roughly 0.15 seconds. The upgrade replaces the TowerBFT voting mechanism with the Votor protocol, letting validators reach consensus through direct off-chain communication and BLS signature aggregation instead of recording every vote on-chain. It is described as Solana's largest consensus overhaul since its 2020 launch.

title.zh: 加州金融监管局致信SEC，反对加密豁免规则架空各州证券法
title.en: California DFPI urges SEC to drop crypto exemptions it says would preempt state securities laws

summary.zh: 加州金融保护与创新局（DFPI）向SEC提交意见信，反对其拟议的《加密资产监管条例》（Regulation Crypto Assets）中对部分数字资产发行的注册豁免，认为该豁免将架空各州证券注册要求，削弱各州对欺诈性发行的执法能力。DFPI警告，豁免可能使投资者失去针对欺诈或滥用发行的保护。该提案于8月发布，目前正处于意见征询后的审议阶段。
summary.en: California's Department of Financial Protection and Innovation filed a comment letter opposing the SEC's proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, arguing its exemptions for certain digital-asset offerings would preempt state registration requirements and weaken enforcement against fraudulent issuance. The DFPI warned investors could lose protections against fraud or abusive offerings. The proposal, unveiled in August, is now under review following the comment period.

title.zh: 美国OCC敲定GENIUS法案稳定币发行人规则，2027年1月18日生效
title.en: US OCC finalizes GENIUS Act stablecoin issuer rules, effective Jan 18, 2027

summary.zh: 美国货币监理署（OCC）10月21日敲定GENIUS法案下的支付型稳定币（payment stablecoin）最终规则，涵盖储备资产、客户赎回、托管与风险管理，规则与法案将于2027年1月18日同步生效。规则要求发行人维持至少100%的储备，并在两个工作日内处理客户赎回请求。最终规则保留了发行人不得直接向持币人支付利息的禁令，但删除了将第三方平台奖励安排一律推定为违规的条款，改为逐案审查。
summary.en: The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency finalized rules for payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act on Oct 21, covering reserves, customer redemptions, custody and risk management; the rules take effect Jan 18, 2027. Issuers must hold reserves at least equal to outstanding coins and generally process redemptions within two business days. The final rule keeps the ban on issuers paying yield directly to holders but drops the presumption that third-party platform rewards arrangements violate it, opting for case-by-case review.

title.zh: Drift Protocol黑客两日内向Tornado Cash转移价值1.09亿美元的ETH
title.en: Drift Protocol exploiter moves $109M in ETH to Tornado Cash over two days

summary.zh: 与4月1日Drift Protocol约2.95亿美元黑客攻击相关的钱包，在10月20-21日两天内向混币器Tornado Cash转移了44,510枚ETH（约1.09亿美元），约占被盗资金的37%。链上追踪机构Lookonchain与Arkham的数据显示，攻击者地址在沉寂约两个月后重新活跃，剩余约5.66万枚ETH（约1.38亿美元）尚未转移。安全公司Mandiant此前已将该攻击归因于朝鲜黑客组织。
summary.en: Wallets tied to the April 1 Drift Protocol hack, which drained about $295 million, sent 44,510 ETH (about $109 million) into Tornado Cash on Oct 20-21, roughly 37% of the stolen funds. Data from trackers Lookonchain and Arkham shows the attacker addresses reactivated after about two months of dormancy, with roughly 56,569 ETH (about $138 million) still held. Security firm Mandiant previously attributed the attack to a North Korean hacking group.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级定于10月26日在Hoodi测试网激活
title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade set for Oct 26 activation on Hoodi testnet

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会确认，Glamsterdam升级将于10月26日17:42:48 UTC在Hoodi测试网激活（epoch 132352），届时测试网区块Gas上限将提升至2亿。这是继10月6日Sepolia测试网激活后的第二次公开彩排，主网激活时间尚未确定。升级核心包括写入协议的提议者-构建者分离（ePBS）与区块级访问列表（block-level access lists），旨在提升并行交易处理能力。
summary.en: The Ethereum Foundation confirmed the Glamsterdam upgrade will activate on the Hoodi testnet on Oct 26 at 17:42:48 UTC (epoch 132,352), raising the testnet's block gas limit to 200 million. It is the second public rehearsal after the Oct 6 Sepolia activation; a mainnet date has not been set. The upgrade's core features are enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS) and block-level access lists, designed to improve parallel transaction processing.

title.zh: 英国FCA就DeFi指引与加密资产监管边界启动两份咨询，2027年新规倒计时
title.en: UK FCA opens two consultations on DeFi guidance and crypto regulatory perimeter ahead of 2027 regime

summary.zh: 英国金融行为监管局（FCA）10月21日发布两份咨询文件：GC26/7 针对使用去中心化金融（DeFi）的受监管企业，就运营韧性（operational resilience）、金融犯罪与反洗钱义务提供合规指引；CP26/36 则厘清新加密资产监管制度下的授权边界与豁免情形。两份咨询均将于11月18日截止，明年1月发布最终指引，而英国全面加密资产制度定于2027年10月25日生效。
summary.en: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) on October 21 opened two consultations: GC26/7 sets out how regulated firms using decentralized finance (DeFi) should handle operational resilience, financial crime and money-laundering obligations, while CP26/36 clarifies the authorization perimeter and exclusions under the incoming cryptoasset regime. Both close on November 18, 2026, with final guidance planned for January 2027 ahead of the UK cryptoasset regime taking effect on October 25, 2027.

title.zh: MoonPay与Upbit母公司Dunamu达成战略合作，探索稳定币全球支付与GIWA生态扩张
title.en: MoonPay and Upbit parent Dunamu announce strategic collaboration on stablecoin payments and GIWA expansion

summary.zh: 加密支付公司MoonPay 10月20日宣布与韩国最大加密交易所Upbit的母公司Dunamu达成战略合作，计划共同探索基于稳定币（stablecoin）的全球支付与资金转移、企业财务与资金管理，以及扩大Dunamu以太坊二层网络GIWA的全球连接。目前尚无商业条款或上线时间表，双方仍在评估技术与商业可行性。这是韩国在《数字资产基本法》（Digital Asset Basic Act）立法推进期间又一起稳定币基础设施布局。
summary.en: Crypto payments firm MoonPay announced on October 20 a strategic collaboration with Dunamu, the parent of South Korea's largest exchange Upbit, to explore stablecoin-based global payments and fund transfers, corporate finance and treasury management, and expanding the global connectivity of Dunamu's Ethereum Layer 2 network GIWA. No commercial terms or launch timeline were given; both sides are still assessing technical and commercial feasibility. The move adds to South Korea's stablecoin infrastructure push as its Digital Asset Basic Act moves forward.

title.zh: 六大公链组织联名致信SEC，要求将“数字商品”定义写入拟议加密规则正文
title.en: Six blockchain groups urge SEC to codify digital commodity definition in binding rule text

summary.zh: Chainlink Labs、Cardano基金会、Hedera、Aptos Labs、Ava Labs与Stellar发展基金会10月20日联名向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交意见信，要求把“数字商品”（digital commodity）作为非证券的定义直接写入《拟议加密资产规则》（Regulation Crypto Assets）的正文条款，而非留在序言与解读性指引中。信中认为，仅靠解释性指引难以给出长期确定性，开发者需要绑定性规则保障。意见提交日恰逢该规则公众评论期截止。
summary.en: Chainlink Labs, the Cardano Foundation, Hedera, Aptos Labs, Ava Labs and the Stellar Development Foundation jointly wrote to the US SEC on October 20, urging it to write the definition of a "digital commodity" as a non-security into the operative text of its proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, rather than leaving it in the preamble and interpretive guidance. The groups argue that interpretive guidance alone cannot provide lasting certainty for builders, and the letter landed on the comment deadline for the proposed rule.

title.zh: 比特币ETF周初获5.27亿美元净流入，以太坊ETF十月流出额突破10.8亿美元创年内最大
title.en: Bitcoin ETFs draw $527M Monday inflow while Ether ETF October outflows top $1.08B, biggest of 2026

summary.zh: SoSoValue数据显示，美国现货比特币ETF周一（10月19日）净流入5.27亿美元，为9月22日以来最强单日，周二再添2300万美元，比特币守住8.3万美元附近。反观现货以太坊ETF，十月净流出已达10.8亿美元，创2026年最大单月流出并吞掉9月全部净流入，十月迄今以太币下跌9.7%至2438美元。资金明显向比特币（Bitcoin）倾斜，ETH ETF全年净流入仅剩约4.85亿美元。
summary.en: SoSoValue data shows US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $527 million in net inflows on Monday, October 19, the strongest single day since September 22, followed by $23 million on Tuesday, with bitcoin holding near $83,000. In contrast, US spot Ether ETFs have shed $1.08 billion so far in October, the biggest monthly outflow of 2026, erasing September's entire $832 million in net inflows as ether fell 9.7% in October to $2,438. Flows are clearly favoring Bitcoin, leaving Ether ETFs with roughly $485 million in year-to-date net inflows.

title.zh: 以太坊质押占比升至35.9%创历史新高，三季度年化收益率降至2.63%
title.en: Ethereum staking hits record 35.9% of supply as Q3 annualized yield falls to 2.63%

summary.zh: Bitwise三季度报告显示，以太坊质押量达到4380万ETH，占流通总量的35.9%，创历史纪录，其中机构与企业参与者推动了质押规模的扩大。增发下行压缩了收益，平均年化质押收益率降至2.63%。分析师指出，质押率攀升锁定了流通供给，但收益下滑意味着锁仓增长未必转化为新增现货需求。Solana质押占比亦达到约69%。
summary.en: Bitwise's Q3 report shows Ethereum staking reached 43.8 million ETH, or 35.9% of total supply, a record high, driven by growing corporate and institutional participation alongside the protocol upgrade. Declining issuance compressed yields, with the average annualized staking yield falling to 2.63%. Analysts note that a high staking ratio locks up circulating supply, but falling yields mean expanding staked balances do not necessarily translate into new spot demand. Solana's staking share also reached about 69%.

title.zh: Ripple向SEC提交20页意见信支持加密规则，主张区分投资合约与代币本身
title.en: Ripple files 20-page comment letter backing SEC crypto rule, urging separation of investment contract from token

summary.zh: Ripple 10月20日向SEC提交20页意见信，公开支持拟议的《加密资产规则》（Regulation Crypto Assets），并请求明确：投资合约（investment contract）与代币本身应作区分，当发行方承诺的必要管理活动结束时，投资合约即终止。首席法务官Stuart Alderoty称公司此前诉讼已花费超1.5亿美元，并呼吁豁免二级市场的普通做市交易。评论期同日截止，SEC接下来将审议约140份意见。
summary.en: Ripple filed a 20-page comment letter with the SEC on October 20 backing its proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, asking the agency to distinguish an investment contract from the token itself, so that the contract ends once the issuer's promised managerial work is complete. Chief legal officer Stuart Alderoty said the company's earlier legal fight cost more than $150 million and urged safe treatment for ordinary secondary-market liquidity provision. The comment period closed the same day, with the SEC now weighing roughly 140 submissions.

title.zh: 瑞士FINMA批准首只面向散户的现货比特币ETF，豁免基金分散化规则
title.en: FINMA approves Switzerland's first retail spot Bitcoin ETF, exempting it from diversification rules

summary.zh: 瑞士金融市场监管局（FINMA）10月20日宣布批准该国首只面向散户投资者的现货比特币ETF，基金直接持有比特币。FINMA以比特币交易历史悠久、成交量远高于其他加密资产为由，豁免了公募基金的风险分散要求，并要求托管机构遵循其2026年1月发布的加密托管指引。FINMA未披露发行方名称，苏黎世的BIT Asset Management随后宣布获得批准，计划11月在瑞士证交所上市（代码BBIT）。
summary.en: Switzerland's Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA) announced on October 20 the approval of the country's first spot Bitcoin ETF open to retail investors, with the fund holding bitcoin directly. FINMA cited bitcoin's long trading history and comparatively high volume to grant an exemption from standard fund diversification rules, while requiring custodians to follow its January 2026 crypto custody guidance. FINMA did not name the issuer; Zurich-based BIT Asset Management later claimed the approval, planning a November listing on SIX Swiss Exchange under ticker BBIT.

title.zh: DeFi Development Corp一周增持3983枚SOL，国库持仓约259万枚SOL
title.en: DeFi Development Corp adds 3,983 SOL, bringing treasury to ~2.59M SOL

summary.zh: 首家以囤积Solana为核心战略的美国上市公司DeFi Development Corp（纳斯达克代码DFDV）10月19日宣布，过去一周国库增持3983枚SOL及等价资产，总持仓达到约2590266枚SOL。同时公司宣布其分红代币CHAD的年化分红率将于11月2日起从13%上调至14%。公司表示将通过质押、验证者节点与链上国库基础设施持续复利SOL头寸。
summary.en: DeFi Development Corp (Nasdaq: DFDV), the first US public company built around a Solana accumulation strategy, announced on October 19 that its treasury added 3,983 SOL and SOL equivalents over the past week, bringing total holdings to approximately 2,590,266 SOL. The company also raised the annual dividend rate of its CHAD token from 13% to 14%, effective November 2. It said it plans to keep compounding its SOL position through staking, validator operations and onchain treasury infrastructure.

title.zh: Autheo发布THEO交易警示：跨链桥被盗170万美元后敦促用户暂停买卖与跨链
title.en: Autheo issues THEO trading advisory after $1.7M bridge exploit, urges users to halt trading and bridging

summary.zh: Autheo Network 10月17日发布安全警示，呼吁用户在调查结束前暂停THEO的买卖与跨链操作。10月12日，攻击者通过Hyperlane跨链桥上的一枚受信任中继者密钥，无授权增发了1900万枚THEO并抛售，套现约700.8枚ETH（约176万美元）后转至以太坊主网。事件导致THEO价格单日暴跌约92%，而该项目此前曾通过Halborn、CertiK等多家机构的审计。
summary.en: Autheo Network issued a security advisory on October 17 urging users to refrain from buying, selling or bridging THEO until its investigation concludes. On October 12, an attacker used a trusted relayer key on the project's Hyperlane bridge on Base to mint 19 million unbacked THEO tokens and sold them, converting the proceeds into roughly 700.8 ETH (about $1.76 million) that was then bridged to Ethereum mainnet. THEO plunged about 92% in a day, despite the project having been audited by firms including Halborn and CertiK.

title.zh: 贝莱德申请第三只比特币ETF：PBIT缓冲型基金，用IBIT期权对冲约10%下行风险
title.en: BlackRock files third Bitcoin ETF "PBIT": a buffer fund using IBIT options to cushion ~10% downside

summary.zh: 贝莱德10月19日向SEC递交初步招股书，拟发行iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF（代码PBIT），这将是其继现货ETF IBIT和备兑收益型ETF BITA之后的第三只比特币基金。PBIT不直接持有比特币，而是通过买卖IBIT期权构建缓冲结构（buffer structure），目标将每期最大亏损限制在约10%，代价是放弃部分上行收益。分析人士认为，这类合规“缓冲”产品正是机构投资者入场所需的包装。
summary.en: BlackRock filed a preliminary prospectus with the SEC on October 19 for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF (ticker PBIT), its third Bitcoin ETF after the spot IBIT and the call-writing BITA. PBIT would hold no bitcoin directly; instead it would use overlapping call option spreads on IBIT to build a defined-outcome buffer structure, targeting a maximum loss of about 10% per tranche while capping upside. Analysts say such a compliance-friendly buffer wrapper is exactly what some institutional allocators need before they can touch bitcoin at all.

title.zh: 比特币跌破8.2万美元：亚洲芯片股重挫拖累风险资产，现货ETF却创近一个月最大流入
title.en: Bitcoin slips toward $81,400 as Asian chip stocks tumble; US spot ETFs post biggest inflow in nearly a month

summary.zh: 比特币周二跌至约8.14万美元，韩国KOSPI重挫3.73%凸显科技股疲软带来的风险厌恶（risk-off）情绪。讽刺的是，美国现货比特币ETF周一反而录得5.266亿美元净流入，为近一个月最大单日流入，其中贝莱德IBIT独揽6.652亿美元。与之形成对比的是，以太坊ETF净流出1.033亿美元，已连续第四个交易日失血。资金向比特币的“避风港化”集中非常明显。
summary.en: Bitcoin slipped to about $81,400 on Tuesday as South Korea's Kospi plunged 3.73% on AI-spending worries, dragging risk assets lower. In a twist, US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $526.6 million of net inflows on Monday — their biggest day in nearly a month — with BlackRock's IBIT alone pulling in $665.2 million. Spot Ether ETFs, in contrast, shed $103.3 million, extending their losing streak to four sessions. The data shows a sharp concentration of institutional demand in bitcoin specifically.

title.zh: Drift Protocol黑客沉寂两月后行动：将13,400至25,700枚ETH转入Tornado Cash洗钱
title.en: Drift exploiter resurfaces after two months idle, sending 13,400–25,700 ETH into Tornado Cash

summary.zh: 与4月Drift Protocol攻击（损失约2.95亿美元）相关的钱包10月20日结束约两个月的沉寂，开始将窃取的ETH转入Tornado Cash混币器。Onchain Lens与Lookonchain追踪到的金额在13,400枚（约3,200万美元）到25,700枚（约6,100万美元）之间，攻击者地址仍持有约81,400枚ETH（约1.94亿美元）。这是继7月之后该资金的第二次大规模洗钱尝试，Mandiant此前将其归因于朝鲜黑客组织UNC6862。
summary.en: Wallets linked to the April Drift Protocol attack (~$295 million lost) woke up on Oct 20 after about two months of silence and began moving stolen ETH into the Tornado Cash mixer. Onchain Lens and Lookonchain tracked between 13,400 ETH (~$32M) and 25,700 ETH (~$61M) entering the mixer over two hours; the exploiter's addresses still hold about 81,400 ETH (~$194M). It is the second major laundering attempt for these funds after July. Mandiant previously attributed the attack to North Korean group UNC6862.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级10月26日登陆Hoodi测试网，区块Gas上限翻倍至2亿
title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade goes live on the Hoodi testnet Oct 26, doubling the block gas limit to 200M

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会确认，Glamsterdam硬分叉（hard fork）将于10月26日17:42 UTC在Hoodi测试网激活，届时区块Gas上限将提升至2亿，为此前在Sepolia测试网运行过的同等参数。这是主网部署前最后一个公开测试步骤，但主网激活日期仍未确定。ETH目前在约2,380美元附近交投，距离9月底高点仍有约15%差距。
summary.en: The Ethereum Foundation confirmed that the Glamsterdam hard fork will activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26 at 17:42 UTC, raising the block gas limit to 200 million — the same parameters already exercised on Sepolia earlier this month. Hoodi is the final public test step before developers commit to a mainnet slot, though no mainnet date has been set. ETH trades near $2,380, roughly 15% below its late-September peak.

title.zh: Solana今日激活Alpenglow共识升级：交易终局时间将从12.8秒缩短至150毫秒
title.en: Solana activates the Alpenglow consensus upgrade today, cutting finality from 12.8s to 150ms

summary.zh: Solana自2020年沿用的TowerBFT共识机制今天将被Alpenglow取代，目标是将交易终局时间（finality）压缩到150毫秒，验证人需运行兼容客户端并注册BLS密钥。升级引入了每epoch 0.8 SOL的验证人准入费，取代原有链上投票费结构。据SolanaFloor数据，截至10月20日仍有约20.3%的质押份额标记为“未就绪”，激活过程是否顺畅成为短期最大看点。
summary.en: Solana is replacing its TowerBFT consensus mechanism — in use since 2020 — with Alpenglow today, targeting transaction finality of 150 milliseconds. Validators must run compatible software and register BLS keys; the upgrade also introduces a 0.8 SOL per-epoch validator admission fee replacing the existing on-chain voting fee structure. Data cited by SolanaFloor shows roughly 20.3% of staked tokens were still marked unready on Oct 20, making a smooth activation the key near-term watch point.

title.zh: Solana链上代币化股票持有人突破140万地址，三季度非投票交易量达89.2亿笔创新高
title.en: Solana tokenized equity holders pass 1.4M addresses; Q3 non-vote transactions hit a record 8.92B

summary.zh: Solana官方X账号10月19日公布，链上持有代币化股票（tokenized equity）的地址数已突破140万个，自9月初以来增长加速。另据Allium数据，第三季度非投票交易量（non-vote transactions，更接近真实用户需求）达89.2亿笔，环比增长24%，较2025年第四季度翻了一倍以上，创季度新高。不过，自动化交易机器人贡献了相当比例的链上活动，活跃用户数与交易笔数并不等同。
summary.en: Solana's official X account reported on Oct 19 that addresses holding tokenized equities on the network passed 1.4 million, with growth accelerating since early September. Allium data shows non-vote transactions — a closer proxy for real user demand — reached 8.92 billion in Q3, up 24% quarter-over-quarter and more than double Q4 2025's level, a new quarterly record. A caveat: automated trading bots account for a significant share of on-chain activity, so transaction counts do not equal user counts.

title.zh: SEC加密资产新规意见征集期结束：收到约140条评论，CLARITY法案流产后SEC继续推进
title.en: SEC's "Regulation Crypto Assets" comment period ends with ~140 submissions; agency advances after CLARITY Act failure

summary.zh: SEC的《加密资产监管规则》（Regulation Crypto Assets）10月20日正式结束公众意见征集，共收到约140条评论。拟议规则允许加密初创公司在特定条件下筹集最高5,000万美元而无需完整证券注册，并设立代币“去证券化”安全港（safe harbor）。在CLARITY法案参议院受挫后，主席Paul Atkins表示SEC将依据现有职权继续推进加密框架。Hyperliquid Policy Center等业界组织已提交修改建议，要求澄清五个条款。
summary.en: The SEC's "Regulation Crypto Assets" proposal closed its 60-day public comment period on Oct 20 with roughly 140 submissions. The draft would let crypto startups raise up to $50 million under lighter disclosure conditions and create a conditional safe harbor for tokens to exit "investment contract" status. After the CLARITY Act stalled in the Senate, Chair Paul Atkins said the agency will press ahead under existing authority. Industry groups including the Hyperliquid Policy Center have filed comments seeking revisions to five provisions.

title.zh: Google更新阿联酋加密广告政策：10月21日起须持本地牌照并通过谷歌认证
title.en: Google tightens UAE crypto ad rules from Oct 21: local licence plus Google certification required

summary.zh: 谷歌宣布，10月21日起，面向阿联酋用户的加密货币交易所和软件钱包广告，必须持有CMA、DFSA、FSRA或VARA四家监管机构之一的牌照，并通过谷歌Ads认证（认证账户将标记“Eligible (Limited)”）。规则适用于全球所有投放阿联酋市场的账户。此举延续了谷歌与各地监管对齐的路线：ICO、DeFi交易协议和未持牌产品的广告依然被禁止。
summary.en: Google announced that from October 21, 2026, ads for crypto exchanges and software wallets targeting UAE users must hold a licence from one of four authorities — the CMA, DFSA, FSRA or VARA — and complete Google Ads certification (compliant accounts will show an "Eligible (Limited)" status). The policy applies to all accounts worldwide advertising to the UAE. It continues Google's alignment with local regulators: ICO, DeFi-protocol and unlicensed-product ads remain prohibited.

title.zh: Cysic跨链桥被黑：攻击者伪造消息在BNB链铸造1,000万枚CYS，约72.7万美元流入以太坊
title.en: Cysic bridge exploited: attacker forged messages to mint 10M CYS on BNB Chain; ~$727K moved to Ethereum

summary.zh: 10月17日，攻击者通过未经授权访问桥接服务的数据库、利用消息处理逻辑漏洞，在BNB智能链上伪造铸造了1,000万枚CYS代币。Cysic在76分钟后拉黑收款地址，冻结了剩余的280万枚，但约720万枚已被出售，约306.6 ETH（价值约72.7万美元）被转移到以太坊。项目方称主网及用户钱包资产未受影响，跨链桥在安全审查期间保持暂停。
summary.en: On Oct 17, an attacker exploited a message-processing vulnerability in Cysic's cross-chain bridge after gaining unauthorized access to a supporting database, minting 10 million unauthorized CYS tokens on BNB Chain. Cysic blacklisted the recipient address 76 minutes later, freezing the remaining 2.8 million CYS — but about 7.2 million had already been sold, with roughly 306.6 ETH (~$727,000) moved to Ethereum. The project says its mainnet and user wallets were unaffected; the bridge stays paused pending a security review.

title.zh: Ledger供应链攻击：硬件钱包被植入间谍芯片经马来西亚经销商流出，损失超9,000万美元
title.en: Ledger supply-chain attack: spy chips hidden in hardware wallets sold via Malaysian retailer; losses exceed $90M

summary.zh: Ledger披露，有组织犯罪集团在经马来西亚经销商CryptoBilis售出的部分Ledger设备中植入了隐蔽芯片。当用户在屏幕上设置助记词（recovery phrase）时，芯片会识别并解码助记词，再通过内置eSIM经LTE无线传出，使攻击者得以清空钱包。区块链研究人员估计损失超过9,000万美元。Ledger已要求港澳及东南亚零售商停售相关设备，OneKey和Trezor也开始审查部分经销商渠道。
summary.en: Ledger disclosed that a highly organized criminal group implanted covert chips inside some Ledger devices sold via Malaysian retailer CryptoBilis. When users set up the device and the recovery phrase appeared on screen, the chip recognized and decoded the words, then transmitted them via LTE using a built-in eSIM — letting attackers drain the wallets remotely. Blockchain researchers estimate losses above $90 million. Ledger has asked retailers in Hong Kong, Macau and Southeast Asia to halt sales of affected devices, and OneKey and Trezor are also reviewing reseller channels.

title.zh: Bitmine再购1.25万枚ETH：持仓达604万枚，逼近总供应量5%目标
title.en: Bitmine adds 12,535 ETH, lifting holdings to 6.04M — 99% of the way to 5% of supply

summary.zh: 由 Tom Lee 担任董事长的 Bitmine Immersion Technologies 上周再度买入12,535枚以太坊（约3,000万美元），总持仓升至6,041,481枚 ETH，约占流通量的4.9%，距离其“5%供应量”目标（Alchemy of 5%）仅一步之遥。公司表示该仓位价值约143亿美元，其每周持续买入的节奏已延续超过14个月，是目前最大的企业以太坊财库。
summary.en: Bitmine Immersion Technologies, chaired by Tom Lee, bought another 12,535 ETH worth roughly $30 million last week, lifting total holdings to 6,041,481 ETH — about 4.9% of Ethereum's supply and 99% of the way to its self-set "Alchemy of 5%" goal. The stake is valued at roughly $14.3 billion. The company's weekly accumulation streak, unbroken since launching its treasury strategy in mid-2025, makes it the largest corporate ETH treasury.

title.zh: 现货比特币与以太坊ETF上周净流出5.49亿美元，以太坊10月流出逼近10亿美元
title.en: Spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs see $549M weekly net outflows; October ETH outflows near $1B

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币与以太坊ETF（Spot ETF）上周合计净流出约5.49亿美元，其中比特币ETF净流出2.29亿美元、以太坊ETF净流出3.2亿美元（数据来源：SoSoValue）。这是比特币ETF连续第二周净流出、以太坊ETF连续第三周净流出，不过相比前一周12.2亿美元的流出规模已明显放缓；以太坊现货ETF的10月累计净流出约9.55亿美元，为今年单月最高。尽管近期承压，两类ETF今年以来的累计净流入仍为正值。
summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs recorded about $549 million in combined net outflows last week, per SoSoValue data — roughly $229 million from Bitcoin funds and $320 million from Ether funds. It was the second straight red week for Bitcoin ETFs and the third for Ether funds, though outflows eased from the previous week's $1.22 billion. Spot Ether ETFs have now seen around $955 million in net outflows so far in October, the heaviest monthly total of 2026, while both ETF categories remain net positive year-to-date.

title.zh: SEC加密资产提案公众意见征询于10月20日截止，市场结构法案前途未卜
title.en: SEC's Regulation Crypto Assets comment window closes Oct 20 as CLARITY bill stalls

summary.zh: 美国证监会（SEC）的《加密资产条例》（Regulation Crypto Assets，S7-2026-27）提案公众意见征询期将于10月20日截止，为 GENIUS 法案稳定币合规框架2027年1月生效前的最后一道公开程序。该提案建立了将支付型稳定币（Payment Stablecoins）排除在证券定义之外的分类体系，截止前夕 Hyperliquid 政策中心等行业机构已密集提交意见。国会层面的《CLARITY法案》（数字资产市场结构法案）依然停滞，SEC 在国会立法缺位下推进自身规则路径。
summary.en: The SEC's proposed Regulation Crypto Assets (S7-2026-27) rulemaking closes its public comment period on October 20 — the last formal window before the GENIUS Act stablecoin compliance framework takes effect in January 2027. The proposal establishes a taxonomy that excludes payment stablecoins from the definition of a security, and drew last-minute comment letters including from the Hyperliquid Policy Center. In Congress, the CLARITY market-structure bill remains stalled, with the SEC advancing its own rulebook workaround.

title.zh: Strive与Strategy合计增持1490枚比特币，Strategy扩大STRC回购计划至30亿美元
title.en: Strive and Strategy buy 1,490 BTC combined; Strategy expands STRC buyback program to $3B

summary.zh: 企业比特币财库（Bitcoin Treasury）公司 Strive 与 Strategy 本周一同步披露增持：Strive 以均价81,734美元购入1,223枚比特币，总持仓达36,818枚；Strategy 则以约2,210万美元买入267枚，均价82,900美元，总持仓升至848,517枚。Strategy 同时将其数字信贷证券回购授权从20亿美元扩大至30亿美元，并以1.93亿美元回购了部分高息优先股（STRC），显示其资本配置重心正从直接购币转向回购低于票面价值（Par）的优先股。
summary.en: Corporate bitcoin treasury firms Strive and Strategy disclosed new purchases on Monday: Strive bought 1,223 BTC at an average of $81,734, lifting holdings to 36,818 BTC, while Strategy added 267 BTC for about $22.1 million at $82,900 each, taking its total to 848,517 BTC. Strategy also expanded its digital credit securities repurchase authorization to $3 billion from $2 billion and bought back $193 million of its high-yield preferred stock STRC, signaling a capital allocation tilt toward repurchasing preferred shares trading below par.

title.zh: Qubic因弱钱包种子被盗约140万美元，网络暂停运行
title.en: Qubic halts network after weak wallet seeds let attacker drain ~$1.4M

summary.zh: 一层区块链（Layer-1）Qubic 在攻击者利用弱随机数生成的钱包种子（Weak Wallet Seeds）从1,404个钱包中盗走约2.94万亿枚 QU（约140万美元）后暂停了网络运行，停于区块高度 tick 85,371,949。受影响的是通过 iPhone/iPad 浏览器、Mac 版 Safari 或旧版 iOS 应用创建的钱包；项目方已用加密安全的随机数函数修复该缺陷（v4.26.4）。约87.1%的被盗资金被冻结在链上，其余流向 MEXC 交易所的部分也被冻结，网络重启时间未定。
summary.en: Layer-1 blockchain Qubic halted operations after an attacker exploited weakly generated wallet seeds to drain about 2.94 trillion QU (roughly $1.4 million) from 1,404 wallets, freezing the network at tick 85,371,949. Affected seeds were generated via browsers on iPhones/iPads, Safari on Mac, or older Qubic iOS app versions; the project fixed the flaw (v4.26.4) by replacing Math.random() with a cryptographically secure random function. About 87.1% of drained funds were frozen on-chain and the rest frozen at the MEXC exchange; no restart date has been announced.

title.zh: Metaplanet进军美国资本市场：Super League股东批准2100枚比特币交易
title.en: Metaplanet moves toward U.S. listing as Super League shareholders approve 2,100 BTC deal

summary.zh: 纳斯达克上市公司 Super League Enterprise 股东批准了与日本比特币财库公司 Metaplanet 的交易提案，Metaplanet 将注入2,100枚比特币与250万美元现金，换取约4,486万股普通股、优先股与认股权证，交易完成后控股约93.7%。交易完成后 Super League 将更名为 Superplanet、股票代码改为 SUPA，成为 Metaplanet 在美国上市的比特币财库平台，目标是提升每股比特币持有量（BTC per share）；交易尚待纳斯达克相关备案等收尾条件。
summary.en: Shareholders of Nasdaq-listed Super League Enterprise approved proposals tied to Japanese bitcoin treasury company Metaplanet's investment, under which Metaplanet will contribute 2,100 BTC and $2.5 million in cash for about 44.86 million common shares plus preferred stock and warrants, giving it roughly 93.7% ownership. Super League will be renamed Superplanet and trade under the ticker SUPA, becoming Metaplanet's U.S.-listed bitcoin treasury platform aimed at growing bitcoin per share. Closing remains subject to customary conditions including Nasdaq filings.

title.zh: DFDV增持3983枚SOL至259万枚，CHAD优先股股息上调至14%
title.en: DFDV adds 3,983 SOL to reach 2.59M treasury; raises CHAD dividend rate to 14%

summary.zh: 纳斯达克上市的 Solana 财库公司 DeFi Development Corp（DFDV）上周增持3,983枚 SOL 及等值资产，财库总量达到约2,590,266枚，继续通过质押与验证节点运营获取收益。公司同时宣布将其可变利率 C 系列优先股（CHAD）的年股息率从13%上调至14%，11月2日生效，每股年派息由1.30美元升至1.40美元。公司表示未来优先股发行所得将主要用于进一步增持 SOL。
summary.en: Nasdaq-listed Solana treasury firm DeFi Development Corp (DFDV) added 3,983 SOL and equivalents last week, bringing its treasury to about 2,590,266 SOL, which it deploys through staking and validator operations. The company raised the annual dividend rate on its variable-rate Series C preferred stock (CHAD) from 13% to 14%, effective November 2, lifting the annual payout to $1.40 per share from $1.30. DFDV said proceeds from future CHAD issuances will be used primarily to accumulate more SOL.

title.zh: Glamsterdam升级定于10月26日激活Hoodi测试网，Gas上限升至2亿
title.en: Glamsterdam set for Hoodi testnet activation on Oct 26 with 200M gas limit

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会（Ethereum Foundation）宣布，Glamsterdam 升级将于10月26日17:42（UTC）在 Hoodi 测试网 epoch 132,352 激活，这是继10月6日 Sepolia 之后、主网前的最后一个公共测试网部署。升级核心包括内嵌的提议者-构建者分离（Enshrined Proposer-Builder Separation, ePBS）与区块级访问列表（Block-Level Access Lists），并将区块 Gas 上限从6,000万提升至2亿。主网激活时间尚未公布，主网用户与持币人无需采取行动。
